visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Name the Pegs by Their Role
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The pegs are called a, b and c, the moves are collected in a global array, and the base case is n === 1. Rename the pegs from, via and to, pass the array in and use the base case n === 0. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Descriptive names make the three roles obvious, the zero-disk base case removes the duplicated push, and passing the array in avoids a global variable.
